name: THE DEATH OF HARSH NOISE
source:
As the world is falling into ruin, Harsh Noise's body is following suit. Worn out by gender dysmorphia, drug addiction, and terminal illness, it can only see one fate on the horizon: Absolute Death.

Is there any salvation possible for a dwindling pack of it/its girls as they each contend with their own kind of existential decay? And just when everything is already at rock bottom, Harsh Noise's distant past goes after a certain trailer park...

[From [url=https://snekofspice.itch.io/the-death-of-harsh-noise]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
当世界陷入毁灭时，刺耳噪音的身体也在效仿。因性别畸形、毒瘾和绝症而疲惫不堪的它只能看到一种命运：绝对死亡。

对于越来越少的它/它的女孩来说，当她们每个人都在与自己的生存衰退作斗争时，有什么可能的拯救吗？正当一切都已陷入谷底时，刺耳噪音的遥远过去追随了某个拖车公园……

[来自[url=https://snekofspice.itch.io/the-death-of-harsh-noise]itch.io[/url]]
